bearing.event.v1alpha1.Observation.schem.description:
Observation is a CloudEvents 1.0 event carrying one observation, in
 structured mode: its ProtoJSON is the CloudEvents JSON form.

bearingsource.description:
The configured source whose event carried the observation. Set by the
 core, never by adapters.

id.description: Stable for the same entity and time; part of the ordering key.

source.description: The adapter's own label, e.g. "adapter/github". Not provenance.

time.description: observed_at of every claim. Truncated to microseconds on ingest.

bearing.event.v1alpha1.Observation.schem.title: Observation

bearing.model.v1alpha1.AttributeClaim.sc.description:
AttributeClaim is an attribute claim that needs times, confidence or an
 ending.

absent.description: Ends the fact instead of asserting it.

value.description: The value. Required, also when absent: an ending ends this value only.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.AttributeClaim.sc.title: Attribute Claim

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Entity.schema.jso.description: Entity is what the observation says about the observed entity itself.

^(linkedIds)$.description:
Keys in linked namespaces that the source records for the entity.
 Identity evidence, never aliases. Complete for the source only if
 linked_ids_complete is set.

^(linkedIdsComplete)$.description:
linked_ids is this source's complete set of links for the entity at
 the observation's time: evidence from this source for any link not
 listed ends then, and an empty list ends all of it. Unset, linked_ids
 only adds evidence and ends none. Set it whenever the source read the
 entity's full set of links.

aliases.description: More keys for the entity, in the source's own or issued namespaces.

attributes.description:
Attribute claims: a value, a list (the complete set) or null (none).
 Omitting an attribute means "not read".

deleted.description: The entity no longer exists in the source.

linked_ids.description:
Keys in linked namespaces that the source records for the entity.
 Identity evidence, never aliases. Complete for the source only if
 linked_ids_complete is set.

linked_ids_complete.description:
linked_ids is this source's complete set of links for the entity at
 the observation's time: evidence from this source for any link not
 listed ends then, and an empty list ends all of it. Unset, linked_ids
 only adds evidence and ends none. Set it whenever the source read the
 entity's full set of links.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Entity.schema.jso.title: Entity

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Evidence.schema.j.description: Evidence says where a person can check an observation's claims.

url.description: A link to the claims in the source.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Evidence.schema.j.title: Evidence

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ObservationData.s.description: ObservationData is the data of an observation event.

^(attributeClaims)$.description: Attribute claims that need times, confidence or an ending.

attribute_claims.description: Attribute claims that need times, confidence or an ending.

evidence.description: Where a person can check the claims; stored on each support.

snapshots.description: Scopes in which this observation lists every fact the source claims.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ObservationData.s.title: Observation Data

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Relation.schema.j.description: Relation is one relation claim about the observed entity.

absent.description: Ends the fact instead of asserting it.

attributes.description: Qualifiers: not part of the fact.

from.description: This key is the subject and the entity the object.

to.description: The entity is the subject and this key the object.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Relation.schema.j.title: Relation

bearing.model.v1alpha1.SnapshotScope.sch.description:
SnapshotScope declares that the observation lists every fact the source
 claims in (source, entity, direction, predicates).

direction.description: Which end the entity is. Required.
direction.title: Direction

predicates.description: Predicate names, or ["*"] for all in that direction. Required.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.SnapshotScope.sch.title: Snapshot Scope
